headline: Community Learning Center grant update including $3,044,986 11th allocation, plus meeting room usage policy and art loan exhibit policy review.
summary: The board will review Community Learning Center projects, including the Hazard Garden, grant close out, and CLC Coordinator Position, with an 11th allocation of $3,044,986. They will also discuss meeting room usage policy, art and object loan policy, library statistics, and upcoming programs.
